text: AI agents can write code and move money. But payment rails still cannot determine whether offchain work met an agreed scope.
ScopeSettle locks the rubric, provider, budget, expiry, and confidence threshold before funding an ERC-8183 escrow on X Layer.
Each deliverable binds one public pull request, its base commit, and one immutable head commit. A moving branch cannot replace the evidence.
Deterministic gates verify repository identity, required files, diff bounds, and CI. The hosted evaluator scores only evidence that survives validation.
Every criterion exposes its score, reason, citations, and limitations. Deterministic code recomputes the weighted result outside the model.
Low confidence made ScopeSettle fail closed. The trusted reviewer rejected the verdict and refunded the full valueless Testnet escrow.
The public certificate recomputes every binding, from report and rubric to evaluator and verdict. Job three verifies ten out of ten.
The open SDK and CLI reproduce every check from X Layer RPC. Integrators never need to trust the ScopeSettle web server.
The wallet-owned console adds scoped keys, signed webhooks, durable retries, and audits. ScopeSettle: verified work, automatic settlement.
